correctness.rationale: For all N>=1 the DCT-II modes are orthogonal, and for i<j the p^2 cosine second-moment identity follows by differentiating the Dirichlet kernel. Since d=j-i and s=i+j-1 have opposite parity, the N-1 terms cancel; cot^2(dπ/2N)-cot^2(sπ/2N)>0 follows by product of positive sines sin((i-1/2)π/N)sin((j-1/2)π/N). Thus Q_{ij} has sign (-1)^(j-i+1), giving floor((N-1)^2/4) negative unordered entries; analyticity implies N>=3 fails at small t; N<=2 explicit semigroup positive. Cauchy-Schwarz gives sufficient late positivity tπ²/L²>ln(N-1); direct spectral projectors for N=3 yield the exact unique cubic transition. Independently recomputed all 2925 offdiagonal entries for N=2..26, maximum abs difference 1.13e-12.
